description: Creates and deletes Route 53 private and public zones.

parameters.name: access_key
parameters.description: AWS access key ID. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys. The AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID or AWS_ACCESS_KEY environment variables may also be used in decreasing order of preference. The aws_access_key and profile options are mutually exclusive. The aws_access_key_id alias was added in release 5.1.0 for consistency with the AWS botocore SDK.

parameters.name: aws_ca_bundle
parameters.description: The location of a CA Bundle to use when validating SSL certificates. The AWS_CA_BUNDLE environment variable may also be used.

parameters.name: aws_config
parameters.description: A dictionary to modify the botocore configuration. Parameters can be found in the AWS documentation https://botocore.amazonaws.com/v1/documentation/api/latest/reference/config.html#botocore.config.Config.

parameters.name: comment
parameters.description: Comment associated with the zone. Default: ""

parameters.name: debug_botocore_endpoint_logs
parameters.description: Use a botocore.endpoint logger to parse the unique (rather than total) "resource:action" API calls made during a task, outputing the set to the resource_actions key in the task results. Use the aws_resource_action callback to output to total list made during a playbook. The ANSIBLE_DEBUG_BOTOCORE_LOGS environment variable may also be used. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: delegation_set_id
parameters.description: The reusable delegation set ID to be associated with the zone. Note that you can’t associate a reusable delegation set with a private hosted zone.

parameters.name: dnssec
parameters.description: Enables DNSSEC signing in a specific hosted zone. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: endpoint_url
parameters.description: URL to connect to instead of the default AWS endpoints. While this can be used to connection to other AWS-compatible services the amazon.aws and community.aws collections are only tested against AWS. The AWS_URL environment variable may also be used.

parameters.name: hosted_zone_id
parameters.description: The unique zone identifier you want to delete or “all” if there are many zones with the same domain name. Required if there are multiple zones identified with the above options.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: A named AWS profile to use for authentication. See the AWS documentation for more information about named profiles https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/userguide/cli-configure-profiles.html. The AWS_PROFILE environment variable may also be used. The profile option is mutually exclusive with the aws_access_key, aws_secret_key and session_token options.

parameters.name: purge_tags
parameters.description: If purge_tags=true and tags is set, existing tags will be purged from the resource to match exactly what is defined by tags parameter. If the tags parameter is not set then tags will not be modified, even if purge_tags=True. Tag keys beginning with aws: are reserved by Amazon and can not be modified. As such they will be ignored for the purposes of the purge_tags parameter. See the Amazon documentation for more information https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws_tagging.html#tag-conventions. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: The AWS region to use. For global services such as IAM, Route53 and CloudFront, region is ignored. The AWS_REGION environment variable may also be used. See the Amazon AWS documentation for more information http://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#ec2_region.

parameters.name: secret_key
parameters.description: AWS secret access key. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys. The AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY or AWS_SECRET_KEY environment variables may also be used in decreasing order of preference. The secret_key and profile options are mutually exclusive. The aws_secret_access_key alias was added in release 5.1.0 for consistency with the AWS botocore SDK.

parameters.name: session_token
parameters.description: AWS STS session token for use with temporary credentials. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys. The AWS_SESSION_TOKEN environment variable may also be used. The session_token and profile options are mutually exclusive.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Whether or not the zone should exist or not. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: A dictionary representing the tags to be applied to the resource. If the tags parameter is not set then tags will not be modified.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: When set to false, SSL certificates will not be validated for communication with the AWS APIs. Setting validate_certs=false is strongly discouraged, as an alternative, consider setting aws_ca_bundle instead. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: vpc_id
parameters.description: The VPC ID the zone should be a part of (if this is going to be a private zone).

parameters.name: vpc_region
parameters.description: The VPC Region the zone should be a part of (if this is going to be a private zone).

parameters.name: vpcs
parameters.description: The VPCs the zone should be a part of (if this is going to be a private zone).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the VPC.

parameters.name: zone
parameters.description: The DNS zone record (eg: foo.com.)

examples:
- name: create a public zone
  amazon.aws.route53_zone:
    zone: example.com
    comment: this is an example

- name: delete a public zone
  amazon.aws.route53_zone:
    zone: example.com
    state: absent

- name: create a private zone
  amazon.aws.route53_zone:
    zone: devel.example.com
    vpc_id: '{{ myvpc_id }}'
    vpc_region: us-west-2
    comment: developer domain

- name: create a private zone with multiple associated VPCs
  amazon.aws.route53_zone:
    zone: crossdevel.example.com
    vpcs:
      - id: vpc-123456
        region: us-west-2
      - id: vpc-000001
        region: us-west-2
    comment: developer cross-vpc domain

- name: create a public zone associated with a specific reusable delegation set
  amazon.aws.route53_zone:
    zone: example.com
    comment: reusable delegation set example
    delegation_set_id: A1BCDEF2GHIJKL

- name: create a public zone with tags
  amazon.aws.route53_zone:
    zone: example.com
    comment: this is an example
    tags:
      Owner: Ansible Team

- name: modify a public zone, removing all previous tags and adding a new one
  amazon.aws.route53_zone:
    zone: example.com
    comment: this is an example
    tags:
      Support: Ansible Community
    purge_tags: true

return_values.name: comment
return_values.description: Optional hosted zone comment. Returned: when hosted zone exists Sample: "Private zone"

return_values.name: delegation_set_id
return_values.description: Id of the associated reusable delegation set. Returned: for public hosted zones, if they have been associated with a reusable delegation set Sample: "A1BCDEF2GHIJKL"

return_values.name: dnssec
return_values.description: Information about DNSSEC for a specific hosted zone. Returned: when state=present and the hosted zone is public

return_values.name: key_signing_key
return_values.description: The key-signing key (KSK) that the request creates. Returned: when state=present Sample: [{"created_date": "2024-12-04T15:15:36.715000+00:00", "digest_algorithm_mnemonic": "SHA-256", "digest_algorithm_type": 2, "digest_value": "xxx", "dnskey_record": "xxx", "ds_record": "xxx", "flag": 257, "key_tag": 18948, "kms_arn": "arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:xxx:key/xxx", "last_modified_date": "2024-12-04T15:15:36.715000+00:00", "name": "ansible-test-44230979--ksk", "public_key": "xxxx", "signing_algorithm_mnemonic": "ECDSAP256SHA256", "signing_algorithm_type": 13, "status": "INACTIVE"}]

return_values.name: created_date
return_values.description: The date when the key-signing key (KSK) was created. Returned: success

return_values.name: digest_algorithm_mnemonic
return_values.description: A string used to represent the delegation signer digest algorithm. Returned: success

return_values.name: digest_algorithm_type
return_values.description: An integer used to represent the delegation signer digest algorithm. Returned: success

return_values.name: digest_value
return_values.description: A cryptographic digest of a DNSKEY resource record (RR). Returned: success

return_values.name: dnskey_record
return_values.description: A string that represents a DNSKEY record. Returned: success

return_values.name: ds_record
return_values.description: A string that represents a delegation signer (DS) record. Returned: success

return_values.name: flag
return_values.description: An integer that specifies how the key is used. Returned: success

return_values.name: key_tag
return_values.description: An integer used to identify the DNSSEC record for the domain name. Returned: success

return_values.name: kms_arn
return_values.description: The Amazon resource name (ARN) used to identify the customer managed key in Key Management Service (KMS). Returned: success

return_values.name: last_modified_date
return_values.description: The last time that the key-signing key (KSK) was changed. Returned: success

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: A string used to identify a key-signing key (KSK). Returned: success

return_values.name: public_key
return_values.description: The public key, represented as a Base64 encoding. Returned: success

return_values.name: signing_algorithm_mnemonic
return_values.description: A string used to represent the signing algorithm. Returned: success

return_values.name: signing_algorithm_type
return_values.description: An integer used to represent the signing algorithm. Returned: success

return_values.name: status
return_values.description: A string that represents the current key-signing key (KSK) status. Returned: success

return_values.name: status_message
return_values.description: The status message provided for ACTION_NEEDED or INTERNAL_FAILURE statuses. Returned: success

return_values.name: serve_signature
return_values.description: A string that represents the current hosted zone signing status. Returned: success

return_values.name: private_zone
return_values.description: Whether hosted zone is private or public. Returned: when hosted zone exists Sample: true

return_values.name: tags
return_values.description: Tags associated with the zone. Returned: when tags are defined

return_values.name: vpc_id
return_values.description: Id of the first vpc attached to private hosted zone (use vpcs for associating multiple). Returned: for private hosted zone Sample: "vpc-1d36c84f"

return_values.name: vpc_region
return_values.description: Region of the first vpc attached to private hosted zone (use vpcs for assocaiting multiple). Returned: for private hosted zone Sample: "eu-west-1"

return_values.name: vpcs
return_values.description: The list of VPCs attached to the private hosted zone. Returned: for private hosted zone Sample: "[{'id': 'vpc-123456', 'region': 'us-west-2'}]"

return_values.name: id
return_values.description: ID of the VPC. Returned: for private hosted zone Sample: "vpc-123456"

return_values.name: region
return_values.description: Region of the VPC. Returned: for private hosted zone Sample: "eu-west-2"

return_values.name: zone_id
return_values.description: Hosted zone id. Returned: when hosted zone exists Sample: "Z6JQG9820BEFMW"
